protocol.final: One post-lock diagnostic final evaluation with fixed artifacts/bands. No model switch or threshold revision after test. No automatic activation, even if eligible.
protocol.mixed_split: Source+label strata: fresh new sources 70/15/15; old-source development-only representatives 85/15/0. Strata under 8 rows are training-only and explicitly counted. No source gets fake test support.
protocol.pre_exposed_policy: All v1 validation/test representatives and their detected exact/template/near families are quarantined globally. Any representative with old-source provenance is development-only. Final v2 test contains only new-source representatives, sealed before fitting.
protocol.selection: Prefer any candidate passing all development gates, then maximize 0.50*(1-worst source error)+0.25*transfer macro recall+0.15*validation F1+0.10*(1-source macro Brier). Ties favor simpler/faster model. No final-test input.
protocol.temporal: No reliable message chronology, so no fabricated temporal split. New synthetic release dates are not sent dates. Source transfer is reported, not called temporal validation.
protocol.thresholds: Use preserved v1 select_thresholds on mixed validation only for each of four fixed candidates. LOSO/source-transfer models choose their own bands using only fitting-source internal validation; held-out source labels never tune a threshold.
protocol.training_balance: After splitting, deterministic training cap of 1500 unique representatives per source/class stratum. No validation/test rebalancing or oversampling.

recipe.usage_notes: Local defensive research using publicly released CSV text. Attribute publishers. CC-BY-SA material and all learned artifacts stay local/ignored; no dataset or model redistribution is part of this milestone. Only subject/body enter features. Generic spam, malformed labels, and empty text are excluded. Publication date is not an email timestamp.
